title: Add Method Security with @PreAuthorize
description: Enable method security and protect controller methods using annotations.
problemStatement:
Extend the previous task by enabling method security and adding @PreAuthorize to controller methods.

1. Add `@EnableGlobalMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)` to your configuration.
2. Create a simple REST controller with the following endpoints:
   - `GET /api/data` – accessible to all authenticated users.
   - `DELETE /api/data/{id}` – accessible only to users with role ADMIN.
   - `GET /api/data/me` – accessible only if the authenticated user's ID equals the path variable `id` (you can simulate a user ID from principal).
3. For the last endpoint, assume that the authenticated principal has an `id` property (you can create a custom UserDetails class, or simply check username). For simplicity, check that the authenticated user's username equals the path variable.

**Hint:** You can get the username from `authentication.principal.username` or `authentication.name`.
hints: Add @EnableGlobalMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true) on the configuration class.
For the 'me' endpoint, you can write: @PreAuthorize("#username == authentication.name") and capture the username as a path variable.
Ensure your users have roles as in task1.
expectedOutput:
After implementing:
- Any authenticated user can GET /api/data.
- Only ADMIN can DELETE /api/data/1.
- GET /api/data/me/john should work only if the authenticated user is 'john' (based on username).
